title: Zesty Venezuelan Candy Cake
description: A fragrant, airy cake infused with citrus zest, sweet candied fruit, and the delicate sweetness of local candy, perfect for a light dessert or festive snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm cake pan.
Whisk 00-flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl until combined.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form, then add whole eggs one at a time, whisking after each addition.
Stir melted butter, milk, citrus zest, and a tablespoon of citrus juice into the dry mixture until smooth.
Fold in the beaten egg whites gently, then fold in candied orange peel and candied cherries.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and level the surface with a spatula.
Bake for 30–35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Remove from oven, cool in pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with a drizzle of candy syrup if desired.
Enjoy the sweet and zesty flavors of this Venezuelan candy cake.
